name: OneHot8
adaptation: Encode eight labels, each an unsigned 3-bit class index 0..7, as an 8x8 byte matrix. Output byte (i,c), packed at 8*i+c, equals in_on when label i equals c and otherwise in_off. All 64 bytes must be produced; values are arbitrary byte patterns, not restricted to 0 and 1. Depth is 8 and the new class axis is last. Width bounds indices to valid classes; no out-of-range source behavior is used.
